name: What are the potential benefits of converting my garage?

mainEntity.name: What are the potential benefits of converting my garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting your garage can offer several significant benefits. It can increase your property value, provide additional living space without the cost of a new extension, or generate rental income if converted into an ADU. It's also a way to maximize existing square footage on your property and potentially avoid moving to a larger home. For some, it creates a dedicated space for work or hobbies, improving quality of life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include increased property value, additional living space, potential rental income, and maximizing existing square footage on your property.
